## Why ATS Implementations Fail

An applicant tracking system should be the backbone of your recruiting operation, but rollouts often fall short of what was promised. Here are seven common mistakes and how to avoid them.

### Mistake 1: Choosing Based on Features, Not Workflow

**The problem:** selecting the ATS with the longest feature list instead of the one that matches how your team works.

**The fix:** map your current hiring workflow, identify bottlenecks, and choose the ATS that solves your top three workflow problems.

### Mistake 2: Insufficient Training

**The problem:** rolling out the system with a single training session and expecting adoption.

**The fix:**

- A training plan for each user role (recruiter, hiring manager, coordinator)
- Hands-on workshops, not just demos
- Quick-reference guides for common tasks
- Designated power users in each department

### Mistake 3: Dirty Data Migration

**The problem:** migrating poor data from old systems into the new ATS.

**The fix:**

- Audit data before migration
- Clean duplicates and outdated records
- Define data standards going forward
- Set an archival policy for inactive candidates

### Mistake 4: No Integration Strategy

**The problem:** the ATS operates as an island, disconnected from email, calendar, HRIS and sourcing tools.

**The fix:**

- Map all integration requirements before selection
- Prioritise calendar sync, email integration and sourcing integrations
- Test integrations during the trial period

### Mistake 5: Over-Customization

**The problem:** customising every field, workflow and template until the system is too complex to maintain.

**The fix:** start with default workflows. Customise only where your process genuinely differs. Review quarterly.

### Mistake 6: Ignoring the Candidate Experience

**The problem:** optimising for recruiter efficiency without considering how candidates use the system.

**The fix:**

- Apply to your own jobs and see what candidates see
- Check the mobile experience
- Keep required fields minimal
- Communicate status clearly

### Mistake 7: No Measurement Plan

**The problem:** no defined metrics to judge whether the ATS is delivering value.

**The fix:** define success metrics before launch:

- Time-to-fill trend
- Recruiter productivity (hires per recruiter)
- Application completion rate
- Data accuracy
- User satisfaction (a short quarterly survey)

### ATS Selection Checklist

Before committing:

- Demo with real scenarios, not canned demos
- Talk to several references of a similar size and industry
- Test the candidate experience on mobile
- Confirm integration capabilities
- Understand the pricing model (per user, per hire, flat)
- Review contract terms, especially exit clauses
